stories.title: Doubleheader Recap — Red Sox 4-3, 2-0; Cubs Fall to WC2

stories.title: October Preview — WCS at Petco Park, Seeding Locked
stories.angle: WC1 is out of reach. Cubs are locked as WC2 heading to Petco Park on Tuesday. Final game (Sunday, Tropicana Field) is moot for seeding — Cubs need Padres to also lose AND win themselves AND records won't tie even then. Bold take: the Padres had 32-16 run since Aug 1. This is a tough draw. But these Cubs are built for the road — they went 45-35 away from Wrigley this year.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
89-71 Padres. 88-73 Cubs. Even with a Sunday win and Padres loss, the records don't tie — they keep WC1 on winning percentage.

Cubs go to Petco Park as the WC2 seed. They also went 45-35 on the road this year.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

research.facts:
WCS at Petco — Seeding Locked
**Key Facts:**
- WC1: Padres 89-71; WC2: Cubs 88-73; WC3: Phillies 87-73
- One game remaining for each team (Sunday Sept 27)
- Cubs' final game moved from Fenway to Tropicana Field, St. Pete due to storm threat
- Cubs cannot reach WC1: even with Cubs win (89-73) and Padres loss (89-72), records differ (.549 vs .553); Padres keep WC1
- Cubs own tiebreakers over Phillies, so WC2 is locked barring losing Sunday and Phillies winning
- WCS: Cubs (WC2, #5 seed) at Padres (WC1, #4 seed) at Petco Park — starts Tuesday Sept 29
- Padres: 32-16 since Aug 1 (per prior pipeline); formidable road opponent
- Cubs road record: 45-35
- **Confidence: HIGH** (standings confirmed by multiple sources including yahoo.com, suntimes.com)

stories.title: Brewers Looming — The NLDS Threat If Cubs Advance
stories.angle: If Cubs survive Petco, they face the 100-win Brewers in the NLDS. Milwaukee clinched the NL Central title for the 4th straight year on Sept 15. First team in MLB history to reach 100 wins without a winning streak longer than 5 games. Cubs are 5-4 vs. Brewers this year. Rivalry + playoff stakes = must-tweet angle for a slow Saturday.

x_posts.text:
100 wins. 4th straight NL Central title. The Brewers went 9-4 against the Cubs this year and they'd host the NLDS.

That's who's waiting if Chicago gets through Petco Park. October just got interesting.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB
